import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXK = 31;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = readLong(sc);
        long base = readLong(sc);
        int[] digits = new java.util.ArrayList<Integer>();
        while (n > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(n % base));
            n /= base;
        }
        int len = digits.size();

        long[][][] A = new long[70][MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] pre = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] suf = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] ans = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        long[][] I = new long[MAXK][MAXK];

        // Initialize identity matrix
        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXK; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAXK; k++) {
                    I[j][k] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                I[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        // Function to multiply matrices
        java.util.function.BiConsumer<long[][][], long[][], long[][]> multiply_matrices = (A1, B, R) -> {
            long[][][] C = new long[70][MAXK][MAXK];
            for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= base; k++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                        C[i][j] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= base; k++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                        C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + A1[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                    R[i][j] = C[i][j];
                }
            }
        };

        // Prepare matrices
        for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= base; j++) {
                A[0][i][j] = 0;
            }
            A[0][i][i] = 1;
            A[0][i][0] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
            // copy A[i-1][0] to pre[0]
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXK; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAXK; k++) {
                    pre[j][k] = A[i - 1][0][k];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j < base; j++) {
                long[][] temp = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
                multiply_matrices.accept(A[i - 1][j], pre[j - 1], temp);
                for (int x = 0; x < MAXK; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < MAXK; y++) {
                        pre[j][y] = temp[x][y];
                    }
                }
            }
            // copy A[i-1][base-1] to suf[base-1]
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXK; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAXK; k++) {
                    suf[j][k] = A[i - 1][base - 1][k];
                }
            }
            for (int j = base - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                long[][] temp = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
                multiply_matrices.accept(suf[j + 1], A[i - 1][j], temp);
                for (int x = 0; x < MAXK; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < MAXK; y++) {
                        suf[j][y] = temp[x][y];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < base; j++) {
                long[][] temp = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
                if (j > 0) {
                    multiply_matrices.accept(pre[j - 1], suf[j], temp);
                } else {
                    multiply_matrices.accept(I, suf[j], temp);
                }
                for (int x = 0; x < MAXK; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < MAXK; y++) {
                        A[i][j][y] = temp[x][y];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize answer
        long[][] answer = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXK; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXK; j++) {
                answer[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= base; i++) {
            answer[i][0] = (i == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        }

        long x = 0;
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int digit = digits.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < digit; j++) {
                long[][] temp = new long[MAXK][MAXK];
                multiply_matrices.accept(A[i][(j + (int) x) % base], answer, temp);
                for (int p = 0; p < MAXK; p++) {
                    for (int q = 0; q < MAXK; q++) {
                        answer[p][q] = temp[p][q];
                    }
                }
            }
            x = (x + digit) % base;
        }

        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < base; i++) {
            res = (res + answer[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res + 1);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long readLong(Scanner sc) {
        return sc.nextLong();
    }
}
